status: Proposed (ADR-011 + TD-23, engineering lead); pending the EXT-07 legal review (TQ-24 / OQ-G6) before pilot. Changing this file is a reviewed edit.

allowed_notes.ADR-011: MIT, BSD, Apache, ISC, MPL-2.0, Zlib, LGPL (dynamic linking only: Python imports and shared libraries are dynamic)
allowed_notes.TD-23: Unlicense / public domain (predicates), 0BSD and CC0-1.0 (numpy components), PSF-2.0 (CPython runtime); GPL / AGPL stay out of shipped images (oracle-test job only)

package_exceptions.name: cffi
package_exceptions.reason: MIT without the attribution clause (strictly more permissive than MIT); required by argon2-cffi-bindings for password hashing (SEC-05).

package_exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
package_exceptions.reason: Browser-support data table used by Next.js tooling; a data licence that requires attribution (listed in the SOUP list).

licence_overrides.name: numba
licence_overrides.source: numba-*.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE (two-condition BSD text). Vendored code (LICENSES.third-party: MIT, BSD, PSF stack, CUDA headers) is part of the EXT-07 review.
